scope: MatePad Edge PC-mode Wine/Steam host windows
sourceState: uncommitted changes preserved; no blanket commit/reset
candidateChanges: Read/observe settings.sceneboard.ispcmode in USER_PROPERTY; retain observer with live Ability owners; preserve static fallback and the last valid value on settings read failures.
PC windows keep system workspace orientation. Fusion session chooses Ability on PC and subwindow on tablet; the carrier remains pinned throughout the session.
Replace shared pending-ID FIFO with LocalStorage identity for toplevel, modal and popup scenes.
Desktop root has one scene owner. PC virtual desktop uses letterbox mapping and no tablet corner padding; surface resizes do not rewrite fixed desktop geometry.
Publish vdImmersive only after FULL_SCREEN; allow retry after request failure; guard intermediate MAXIMIZE during restoration. Honor floating preference and compare the actual window-mode key.
Managed GDI and GPU-capable windows share the PluginManager compositor; NativeBuffer Direct queue consumers retain per-toplevel isolation and fence synchronization without CPU image readback.
Managed title drag is owned by WMS and does not modify the Wayland virtual origin.

Border dragging marks resizing configures and suppresses Wine-to-host geometry feedback until the final content acknowledgment or a bounded resize-end fallback. Host configure requests drain on the Wayland event thread.

One IME coordinator attaches to the actual host window after Wine activates editable focus, follows WINDOW_ACTIVE/INACTIVE across visible PC windows, and removes only its own callbacks. Delayed callbacks cannot submit to a different host.
An attached IME delivers Enter through sendFunctionKey; legacy orphan-key-up synthesis remains available only when no IME session owns input.
